# trajectory control point

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:trajectoryControlPoint`](gmeow-trajectoryControlPoint.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/trajectoryControlPoint>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/music`](../../slices/music.md)

Relates a [`PitchTrajectory`](../classes/gmeow-PitchTrajectory.md) to one of its ordered control points. Non-functional: a trajectory has many control points.
